scope: Isolated command-resolution checks; no browser input

results.name: Left click always selects a visible current-player unit in normal, move and attack modes
No selected unit inspects instead of issuing a command
A selected unit moves on one left click or right click
Right click never changes selection to another own unit
A visible enemy is attacked directly without confirmation
Building and garrison use one direct attack
Attack choices omit air targets when the attacker lacks AA
A neutral building receives movement from an adjacent cell
A distant neutral building first receives a direct movement command
Explicit capture never falls back to movement or attack
Capture mode works on the selected unit standing on a sea platform
Automatic deployment setting accepts occupied compatible tiles without selecting their unit
Deployment setting validates facility, range and queued unit terrain
Allied buildings cannot be captured and allied units cannot be attacked
Movement respects remaining AP, energy, anchor and terrain
Artillery cannot attack after moving and indirect attacks still need visibility
Sniper requires an unmoved attacker and honors cooldown
Shock can target a unit but not a co-located building
Repair mode repairs a friendly unit instead of selecting it
Repair offers two damaged friendly targets on a shared tile
Repair rejects self, full HP, foundations and already-repaired targets
Jam targets visible enemies including aircraft, but not buildings or protected units
Self buffs and scan issue target-free commands
Passive skills do not become active commands
Deployment commits directly and rejects incompatible terrain
Construction commits directly and retains placement and money checks
Hidden blockers do not affect direct movement or target errors
Hidden aircraft do not reveal themselves via capture, deploy or construction cursors
Last observed hidden buildings are inspectable, never blind attack or capture targets
Hidden changes to known building ownership/HP do not alter command resolution
Observation mode never commands another actor and story lock blocks orders
Malformed cells, IDs and modes return errors without throwing
